visual_observations.finding: Four separate round low duct rims arranged in a square, with a narrow open central area. Adjacent rims do not overlap. Four bowed radial braces descend from each ring to a low triangular motor pad. Braces are not coplanar with ring or motor.

Each motor pad has a central shaft clearance hole and three smaller bolt holes. Three local raised retaining/screw guards surround bolt locations. Four brace attachment directions per duct are irregularly spaced and mirrored across vehicle axes.

Connecting structure includes two narrow front/rear bridges with small outward triangular nose/tail markers, two curved lateral connecting braces and four cardinal mounting bosses around the battery cradle. Large negative spaces are essential.

Very open flexible skeleton. Camera collar with short protective upper lip and an opening above lens; front central mounting tongue; two long slender side legs; narrow rear perforated strip bends into arch when installed. Exposed camera PCB and electronics remain visible through large side openings.

Large black circular lens housing in milky collar, smaller recessed green/blue reflective optical element, dark rectangular PCB directly behind lens tilted back from vertical. Optical axis points forward and upward. Do not model as a sphere.

Three clear low-pitch blades per motor, 120 degrees apart, broad curved paddle/swept profiles with rounded tips and narrow roots. Raised cylindrical hub has central shaft opening. Curvature/twist changes which blades appear edge-on.

Short silver cylindrical bells, exposed colored top spokes and copper windings, black lower mounting region. Three black wires leave each motor as a parallel bundle and terminate at small white plugs under board perimeter.

Black PCB is an elevated thin square/diamond relative to motor grid, with green/gold edge, tiny flat black chips, silver/gold pads and white motor connectors. Camera is prominent and central-front, board extends visibly behind and to sides. Red/yellow/black camera wires are flexible, with a red diagonal lead over board in manufacturer view.

Optional long narrow rectangular LAVA II pack sits lengthwise under center inside integrated two-loop plastic cradle; label green/yellow/black, silver side foil, black end cap and white BT2.0 connector. Battery is absent from main top product view, present in underside reference.

Prominent black straight tubular top with a wider tapered heatshrink base, supported in rear canopy opening and angled upward/backward; this is substantially thicker than Champion whip. White/blue battery U-pigtail also visible near rear board edge.

Reproduce skeletal canopy, lens diameter/pose, high exposed camera PCB and antenna direction; never use a closed generic bubble.

Tune translucent lavender and white PP, clear props, metal roughness and optical tint using real photographs; manufacturer image whites are heavily studio-lit.
